fullContentHtml:
HPSC Civil Service Mains Admit Card 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Haryana Public Service Commission (HPSC) has released the mains admit card for the recruitment of Civil Services Examination 2026. This recruitment was released for 102 posts. Applications for the HPSC Haryana Civil Service HCS Recruitment 2026 were accepted from February 06, 2026, to February 26, 2026. The mains examination is going to be conducted on 27, 28 & 29 June 2026. Candidates who qualified for this pre examination can download their HPSC Civil Service HCS Mains Admit Card 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Notification Date : 30 January 2026
  • Application Start Date : 06 February 2026
  • Last Date : 26 February 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 26 February 2026
  • Exam Date : 26 April 2026
  • Admit Card : 20 April 2026
  • Answer Key : 28 April 2026
  • Prelims Exam Result : 04 June 2026
  • Revised Prelims Result : 01 June 2026
  • Mains Exam Date : 27, 28 & 29 June 2026
  • Mains Admit Card : 22 June 2026
  • Interview Date : August / September 2026

Application Fee

  • General, EWS : Rs. 1000/-
  • SC, BC, ESM : Rs. 250/-
  • Female All Category : Rs. 250/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

How to Download Admit Card

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the admit card / hall ticket link.
  3. Enter your registration number / roll number and date of birth / password.
  4. Click on submit to view your admit card.
  5. Download and take a printout. Carry it to the exam center along with a photo ID.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is HPSC Civil Service Mains Admit Card 2026?

HPSC Civil Service Mains Admit Card 2026 is a government exam related notification. Complete details including important dates, fee, eligibility and links are provided above.

What is the last date to apply?

The last date to apply is 26 February 2026.

Where can I find the official website?

The official website is: https://hpsc.gov.in/en-us/

How to download admit card?

Click on the relevant link in the Important Links section above or visit the official website directly.
